issue.title: bench_tui_trace warm clan-wave bench stub returns (None, {}) but project_clan_tree dereferences wave_summary.layered
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1tz.2.1.13 notes #1 and #5. The sase-1tz.2.1 land agent triaged it on master fb85972f27 (2026-11-20). Epic sase-1tz.2.1 did not cause it.

## Reproduction (deterministic, slow-marked bench)

    .venv/bin/python -m pytest -s -m slow tests/perf/bench_tui_trace.py::test_warm_clan_wave_projection_large_roster_stays_near_legacy

Fails every run. The other six nodes in the file pass, so the file result is 1 fail / 6 pass at fb85972f27.

## Root cause

To time the "legacy" (pre-wave) path, the bench monkeypatches `sase.ace.tui.models._agent_clan_waves.project_clan_wave_model` with `lambda _clan_name, _units, **_kwargs: (None, {})`. `project_clan_tree` in `src/sase/ace/tui/models/_agent_tree_clan.py` imports that function inside the function (line ~385), so the patch applies. It then unpacks `wave_summary, wave_slots` (line ~405) and dereferences `layered=wave_summary.layered` (line ~440), which raises AttributeError on `None`. The dereference arrived with 8953f46b80 (sase-1lc.3, "show clan dependency waves in agent lists", 2026-10-15). That landed after the bench was written (91350ad5b6, sase-1lc.2). `project_clan_wave_model`'s declared return type is the non-optional `tuple[ClanWaveSummary, dict[str, ClanWaveSlot]]`, so the stub is the side that is out of contract.

## Fix direction

Make the bench's legacy stub return a minimal, valid, non-layered `ClanWaveSummary` (plus `{}`) that matches the pre-wave behavior, rather than `None`. Do not add a `None` guard in production code. Keep the warm-memo `hits_before > 0` and overhead assertions unchanged. Because the bench is `-m slow`, the default lanes do not catch this.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails on every run, including standalone: the bench's legacy stub returns (None, {}) and src/sase/ace/tui/models/_agent_tree_clan.py unconditionally dereferences wave_summary.layered, an AttributeError that does not depend on timing or load.

issue.creation_reason: A phase verification run hit this deterministic slow-bench failure on a clean base; the bench stub has been out of contract with project_clan_wave_model since mid-October and no task tracks it.
